Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.action

Schnittstelle NpcActionHandler

public interface NpcActionHandler
Carries out one kind of NPC action.

The extension point behind ActionDefinition: registering a handler with ActionRegistry makes myaction: something usable in every NPC's configuration, in /npc action, and in every existing NPC without BetterNPCs knowing what it does.

Implementations must be thread safe in the sense that they hold no per-execution state — execute(ActionContext) may be entered for several players in the same tick, and a handler that keeps state in a field will mix them up. Per-execution state belongs in ActionContext.attribute(String, Object).

  • Methodendetails

    • id

      String id()
      Returns the id this handler is addressed by in configuration.

      Must be lower case, and must not contain a colon or whitespace, matching the constraints ActionDefinition enforces on a type.

      Gibt zurück:
      the id, for example message

    • aliases

      default Set<String> aliases()
      Returns alternative ids that resolve to this handler.

      Same constraints as id(). Useful for keeping an old name working after a rename.

      Gibt zurück:
      the aliases; empty by default

    • argumentDescription

      default String argumentDescription()
      Returns a short description of what the argument should look like, shown in command help.
      Gibt zurück:
      the description, for example "<MiniMessage text>"

    • validate

      default void validate(String argument)
      Checks an argument before it is stored.

      Called when an action is added through a command or loaded from storage, so that a typo is reported at the point it is made rather than the first time a player clicks the NPC. The default accepts anything.

      Must not have side effects and must not touch the world — it runs during startup, before the server is necessarily ready.

      Parameter:
      argument - the argument to check
      Löst aus:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the argument cannot be executed, with a message suitable for showing to whoever typed it

    • execute

      void execute(ActionContext context)
      Carries out the action.

      Called on the main server thread. Work that would block — a database read, an HTTP call — must be moved off it and its result scheduled back, exactly as anywhere else in a plugin.

      Parameter:
      context - everything the action needs
      Löst aus:
      RuntimeException - if the action fails; the engine logs it with the NPC and player as context and continues with the next action in the chain
